extraction_scope: Worker-6 adjudication reframed mechanism evidence as source-reviewed biophysical and structure-activity context; no direct membrane-killing mechanism is overclaimed.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: KR12-NH2 and N-terminally acylated/aromatic analogs I-X
mechanism_claims.claim_text: N-terminal lipidation/aromatic modification changes hydrophobicity and is associated with the observed antimicrobial activity profile, with C8-KR12-NH2 and trans-cinnamic acid-KR12-NH2 among the more active analogs.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a structure-activity correlation from MIC/MBEC tables and hydrophobicity context, not a direct molecular killing mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD measurements show environment-dependent helical content for the peptides in water, PBS, DPC, SDS, POPG, and POPC.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Helicity data support structural context but do not by themselves establish a direct antimicrobial mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Surface-tension and NMR/DOSY evidence supports self-assembly context for selected lipopeptides; larger aggregation for C14-KR12-NH2 is used by the paper to explain reduced activity relative to C8-KR12-NH2.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Self-assembly is an indirect explanatory context; no exact figure-derived quantitative points were promoted beyond the local source support.
